label: bb_irivm_a1e1_r05_m05_inf4080_r2
mechanism: The fixed-central-tangent discrete proximal subproblem reached m_max=5 before its requested relative natural-residual condition was met.

Its five deterministic H0/L-BFGS trial states were locally descending for the frozen proximal model, but the I_perp-monotone whole-path globalization accepted no image update at the terminal retained path.
Because the retained path, central tangents, and call-free FFrbk preconditioner were unchanged, the next outer solve generated the same five coordinates exactly.
Those coordinates were already in the run-local exact-coordinate cache, so repeated outer solves added neither a physical force evaluation nor a retained-path displacement.
The source-level guard stops after three such zero-cost, zero-displacement outer iterations. This guard diagnoses a numerical stall; it is not an I_perp=0 convergence test.

disabled_fallback.effect: This branch would change active_plbfgs_kkt_rtol and reset outer memory, but the frozen discrete_b040 call receives discrete_residual_ratio directly. Therefore the present source does not establish that enabling this branch would change the repeated five-step discrete trial sequence; at most it could reset memory and delay the same stall test.
disabled_fallback.identity_note: The Chignolin production command also leaves this option disabled. It is not one of the three declared tuning controls and is not a justified escape mechanism for the present discrete_b040 stall.

migration_comparison.runner_core_review: The BB runner differs from the Chignolin runner only in the system adapter, frozen endpoint cache, call-free BB force-field preconditioner builder, committed storage, and NoF/audit fields; the outer cached-stall and I_perp-globalization logic is unchanged.

scientific_interpretation: The evidence supports an incompatibility at this late path between the m_max=5 inexact frozen-tangent subproblem and the strict I_perp-monotone outer globalization. It does not prove that m_max alone is the unique cause; alpha and r jointly determine the frozen subproblem trajectory.
permitted_next_actions: Run a different preregistered (alpha,r,m_max) setting from the common initial path.

If a targeted m_max=8 or m_max=10 long-budget follow-up is desired, preregister it as a new parameter setting before its first physical call; this changes only one of the three declared tuning controls and preserves IR-IVM identity.
forbidden_interpretations: the remaining 1023 NoF were saved by convergence
repeated cache hits should be counted as new Number of Forces
